data.narrative:
Positron AI is a Series B semiconductor company founded by Thomas Sohmers, Barrett Woodside, and Edward Kmett, currently valued above $1.0B post-money on $230M+ raised. The valuation assessment draws from a comp universe of 3 public semiconductor players (ALAB, NVDA, AMD) and 8 private frontier-chip companies including SambaNova Systems, Etched, and Cerebras.

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.9x multiplier to the $1.0B last post-money valuation, yielding $1.9B. Peer-median benchmarking across four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage companies produces a $3.5B implied value, with individual peer valuations ranging from $529M (DEEPX, Series C) to $11.0B (SambaNova Systems, Series A). Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiples (21.4x median across the three public comparables) cannot be applied due to absence of target revenue disclosure, typical for private companies.

The triangulated range spans $1.6B to $4.0B, with a median of $2.7B. The stage-progression method provides a conservative floor, while the peer median reflects broader market positioning but carries wide dispersion risk given the nascent stage and heterogeneous funding profiles within the chip-design cohort. Key uncertainties include target revenue trajectory, capital efficiency relative to peers, and the sustainability of current frontier-chip valuations amid cyclical semiconductor dynamics.
